preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 20,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 200000 for n in ns_list)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and x in (0, 1) for x in a) for a in bosses_list)
preconditions.description: Each boss type in every test case is either 0 (easy) or 1 (hard).
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a valid integer representing the minimum skip points.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_lines[i] == str(min_skip_points(bosses_list[i])) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, the output is the minimum number of skip points required for the friend to kill all bosses, where the friend moves first and alternates with the player, each killing 1 or 2 bosses per turn, and skip points are only needed for hard bosses (type 1) killed by the friend.
